about_the_game:
Shifting Lunacy tells the story of a young psychiatrist facing three surreal nights on duty.

Amidst the spread of apocalyptic rumors, resident doctor Mare is assigned her very first night shift. Caring for critical patients is already a delicate balance, but when a series of unexpected incidents begins to unfold, the pressure grows unbearable.

As the nights progress, reality and delusion intertwine, and strange, unexplainable events creep into her ward. What begins as a night shift soon transforms into three nights of madness, paranoia, and the surreal—drawing Mare closer to the edge of the unknown.

Key Feature:

  • Authentic VHS Aesthetics: A gritty CRT filter immerses you in era-specific terror.

  • Unknown Surreal Horror: Enter different worlds of shifting characters

  • Psychological Tension: Balance duty and sanity during three apocalyptic nights.

  • Story-rich: Exploring multiple endings of the game and the plots behind each character.

Game Play:

  • Walk and Investigation

  • Role-Switching – Step into the lives of different patients and unravel the secrets behind their fears.

  • Puzzle-solving elements 

  • Choices matter
